content: After untying parameters in the softmax prediction layer, implicit discourse relation classification performance was improved across all four relations, meanwhile, the explicit discourse relation classification performance was also improved. The CRF layer further improved implicit discourse relation recognition performance on the three small classes. In summary, our full paragraph-level neural network model achieves the best macro-average F1-score of 48.82% in predicting implicit discourse relations, which outperforms previous neural tensor network models (e.g., BIBREF18 ) by more than 2 percents and outperforms the best previous system BIBREF19 by 1 percent.
